findings.claim: First cut had 6 FP2 holes (empty image stats->MEASURED; string strain swallowed->STABLE; compile-only graph fabricated invokes=True; KE-runaway-from-rest->STABLE; too-few-frames->STABLE; KE-gap-all-windows->STABLE). All fixed at root in commit 6f8a158a; 6 regression tests in TestFP2Regressions; one existing test that had CODIFIED the too-few-frames gap was corrected.

The re-verify pass flagged a detection-sensitivity nuance (NOT an FP2 violation): the malformed-signal guard ran BEFORE the explosion rules and covered all signals, so a corrupt INFORMATIONAL field (max_velocity, scored by no rule) could mask a real NaN explosion into UNKNOWN. Fixed a6db2286: the explosion rules run first (a definite blow-up wins), and the malformed->UNKNOWN check runs after, scoped to the JUDGED signals (kinetic_energy, max_strain). Pinned by tests::test_real_explosion_not_masked_by_unrelated_malformed_field.
